authority: Derived from Leah-approved Case 2 and Case 6 researcher-inventory workbooks; these are the calibration archetypes.

archetypal_principles.coverage: Inventory all materially useful researcher-selectable coordinates at the workbook resolution. Do not use a deliberately sparse summary.
archetypal_principles.lexical_fidelity: Preserve source wording separately and exactly enough that colloquial, figurative, uncertain, negative and question forms remain available without semantic normalization.
archetypal_principles.researcher_tags: Short tags may summarize only for navigation; they never replace source wording.
archetypal_principles.qualities: Use qualities_available/Q to signal that source qualities exist without exploding the quality bundle into a full APA parse.
archetypal_principles.verbs: Source happenings are independently inventoryable and are not collapsed into nouns or psychological summaries.
archetypal_principles.locators: Physical, directional and materially useful figurative locators are independently inventoryable when they may matter later.
archetypal_principles.compounds: Compounds are lightweight researcher bindings composed only from registered unit refs. They do not assert APA semantics.
archetypal_principles.provisionality: Questions, uncertainty, hypothetical futures, negations and speaker-proposed labels remain provisional in exactly that posture.
archetypal_principles.forbidden: No protected-thread determination, APA scoring, psychological inference, APA-ID minting, promotion or Oval Office write.
